QuestInfo.name: Phil's Call
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p101#, the informant of #m10000000#, has something to say to all novice adventurers who have just arrived on Victoria Island.
QuestInfo.1: #p101#, the informant of #m10000000#, explained that once you reach Level 10, you can make a job advancement in each town of Victoria Island. They asked me to help out the townsfolk in #m10000000# and hunt monsters to reach Level 10, then return.
QuestInfo.2: After reaching Level 10, I was able to get information about the job advancement from #b#p101##k. It seems you can advance to a Warrior in #m10004000#, a Magician in #m10002000#, an Archer in #m10001000#, and a Thief in #m10003000#. Talking to #p101# will allow you to go straight to your town of choice. Since a job advancement cannot be undone once made, I'd better choose carefully...

0.0: You look like a novice adventurer who has just arrived on Victoria Island. Welcome to #b#m10000000##k! Your real adventure begins now, so you'd better brace yourself.
0.1: But it seems you don't even have a proper job yet. At this rate, you'll find it hard to even leave this area. Don't worry, though. That's why I'm here as the town's informant for adventurers like you. So, how about it? Want to hear about the job advancement?

yes.0: Great! To make a job advancement, you need to reach Level 10 and then visit the various towns across Victoria Island. Once you reach Level 10, come back to me and I'll explain the rest in more detail.
yes.1: How do you reach Level 10, you ask? Heading out of town to hunt monsters is one way, but helping out the townsfolk here with their favors will also get you the items you need for your adventure, killing two birds with one stone.
yes.2: It looks like #p107# and #p102# have some favors to ask of adventurers, so why not go hear what they have to say? Come back and find me once you reach #rLevel 10#k!

no.0: Turning down my information... you must be pretty confident in yourself!

1.0: Seeing how different your eyes look compared to when we first met, you must have reached Level 10! Now you look ready to begin your real adventure.

yes.0: Well, you can't stay a beginner forever, right? All right! Now that you've reached level 10, you can choose to advance to one of the following classes: #rSwordsman#k, #rMagician#k, #rArcher#k, or #rRogue#k.
yes.1: To become a Swordsman, you need to go to #m10004000#; to become a Magician, you need to head to #m10002000#; to become an Archer, you need to go to #m10001000#; and to become a Rogue, you need to make your way to #m10003000#. They're all towns located on Victoria Island, but it can still be quite a long journey to get to them.
yes.2: But, you know, there are always a few... unusual ones. I'm talking about the ones who choose to stay beginners and never advance. Hahaha! But I'm sure you're not the type to make that choice, right?
yes.3: Anyway, once you've decided which job you want to advance to, come talk to me again. #rI can send you to the town you need to get to at a special discounted price, just for beginner adventurers!#k

default.0: Don't forget to reach Level 10 and come back!
